entities.summary: Kevin B. Sullivan is an American politician. A Democrat, he was the 106th Lieutenant Governor of Connecticut, from 2004 to 2007. He was elected to the Connecticut State Senate in 1986 and served as Senate President Pro Tempore from 1997 to 2004. He was a 2024 presidential elector, pledged to cast his vote for Kamala Harris.
